subject: POC capacity bump request — week-of 2027-02-22 throughput run
messages:
From: Alex Durand <alex.durand@quantumanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantumanalytics.com
Date: 2027-02-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC capacity bump request: week-of 2/22 throughput run

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

We're targeting a controlled throughput validation the week of Feb 22 to validate latency under load for our real-time inference pipeline. The initial pilot ran well, but the next phase needs sustained token throughput to surface bottlenecks in our batching and KV cache behavior.

Can Redwood temporarily increase our trial credits or provide a promo top-up so we can run a full-day stress window (approx 24 hours) at an estimated 750k tokens/hour? Rough numbers below:
- Target test window: 24 hours (one-day run)
- Expected total tokens: ~18M tokens
- Peak concurrent requests: 600 TPS to the inference endpoint

We'd like confirmation of the available uplift by EOD Tuesday so we can lock the test schedule. Procurement is on Cc for any paperwork.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Durand
Head of ML Platform — Quantum Analytics
alex.durand@quantumanalytics.com

---
Note: attaching the test harness summary in a follow-up.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC capacity bump request: week-of 2/22 throughput run

Alex —

Thanks for the detail. We can support a one-day stress window but need to confirm the exact uplift mechanism. Two paths:

1) Promo credit top-up (fastest) — we can issue temporary credits tied to the HubSpot deal; requires approval from finance for anything >1M tokens equivalent.
2) Short-term Dedicated reservation (recommended for sustained TPS) — takes longer to provision but gives predictable throughput; requires a minimum commitment.

To move fast, please confirm which path you prefer. If promo credits, confirm the token budget you'd like Redwood to provision (we can propose 12M or 20M). If you need an SLA-backed Dedicated run we can start the provisioning checklist but that may push the window out ~2–3 business days.

Looping in Aditya for approval of a promo uplift if you choose that route. Also, Marissa — I expect the POC plan and any usage snapshots as attachments.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-02-16T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC capacity bump request: week-of 2/22 throughput run

Alex — attaching the POC load plan and the most recent usage snapshot we received from your test harness (see attachments: POC-load-plan.xlsx, usage_snapshot.json). Quick notes from our ops team:

- The 600 TPS peak will be handled by our public hosted pool if we provision a temporary burst reservation.
- For a credit-style approach we recommend provisioning 18M tokens to cover the full window plus a 10% buffer (so ~19.8M tokens).
- As an alternative offer for speed, Redwood can grant a one-time promotional top-up equal to 20M tokens tied to deal QAN-2027-0482. This would be a limited-time promo and expire 7 days after issuance.

If you confirm the promo route I will draft the top-up and share the internal approval thread (we'll need Aditya's sign-off for the token quantity). Also flagging that procurement may need an addendum if there are any contractual changes; Naomi — happy for you to coordinate the DocuSign if needed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs:
- POC-load-plan.xlsx (xlsx)
- usage_snapshot.json (application/json)

Date: 2027-02-17T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC capacity bump request: week-of 2/22 throughput run — finance approval

Naomi / Marissa —

Reviewed the request and the rough token economics. Approving a one-time promotional credit of 20,000,000 tokens (promo code: REDWOOD-PROMO-QAN-2027-0482) for Quantum Analytics to run the scheduled throughput validation. Notes:
- Credit valid for 7 days from issuance.
- No additional cash discount; this is a promotional uplift against the hosted account.
- Require a signed addendum to the MSA for any extended Dedicated provisioning — procurement, please coordinate via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?token=ABC123-POC-ADDENDUM

Marissa — please issue the promo code and confirm usage tracking so we can reconcile after the run. Naomi — please confirm with the customer that 20M is sufficient or whether they want us to increase to 25M (we can approve up to 25M for this account under the promo budget).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the promo — confirming Quantum Analytics will take the 20M token promotional uplift (REDWOOD-PROMO-QAN-2027-0482). Procurement will review the addendum and route the DocuSign link internally today.

We're standing up the harness on Monday and will run the 24-hour window on Wed 2/23 (UTC time window starting 06:00 UTC). I'll post a short summary in this thread when the run completes with key latency percentiles and token consumption.
